latest_attempt.name: v12r37
latest_attempt.result: The guarded physical NPU0-3 launch passed resource isolation, HCCL, model loading, DASC activation, and worker dispatch while the frozen foreign TP4 service remained on NPU4-7. All four workers failed before readiness because the Ascend ordinary-attention reshape treated each split K/V buffer's dense-page slack as payload. This is cache-layout mechanism evidence; no numerical request ran.

Honor the 24-hour piercing deadline: if v12r38 fails, permit at most two evidence-driven corrective NPU iterations. If strict replay passes, immediately run matched performance then required GSM8K; otherwise publish an explicit partial-mechanism or failure conclusion instead of extending exploration.

Keep the request-lifecycle regression gate: first Load zero-fills omitted heads, a normal step updates them, same-request block transition preserves them, and release/reactivate zero-fills them again while restoring retained heads.

Treat the TP4 MAX-padding tax as measured, not hypothetical: W_max=64 retains 1728 raw heads but stores 2084 after contiguous layerwise rank equalization. The exact whole-GQA-group TP4 bound is 1828; 1788 is only the arbitrary-per-head lower bound. If v12r7 is correct but weak, compare coupled group permutation against paper-equivalent variable-split Store/Load rather than tuning around the 1.11x temporal ceiling.

Do not launch v12r6; its controller now fails closed on the semantic supersession. Prepare a newly named immutable attempt only after request identity, release/resume, metadata remapping, and graph-pointer gates pass.
Do not start formal performance or quality work unless a materially different successor passes service, strict canary, activation, ownership, and physical-byte verification.
Use commit 5f93b14 cache-hit quality adapter for formal quality runs; --require-cache-hit must fail closed on a zero hit delta.
Use the hash-pinned tokenizer context audit and max_model_len=44032 for both formal arms; reject truncation and the preserved invalid two-token audit.
Only after a materially different successor passes the physical mechanism gate, run the one-switch cache-hit TTFT and input-throughput benchmark.

successor.v12r21_startup_guard: The operator-authorized physical NPU4-7 run completed without a resource race and failed the strict numerical canary. A later evidence audit corrected the initial verdict: the only gdn_running_state_indices_remapped event per worker was emitted before the physical copy and showed 12->12, while the first resumed-token boundary actually showed native metadata row 25 remapped to destination row 3. The physical copy itself used manager rows 2->3. Because the aggregate attention-first cache exposes 12 virtual kernel blocks per 1536-token manager block, raw GDN metadata row 25 normalizes to manager row 2. The real defect was failure to normalize kernel block ids during ordinary GDN execution, which caused state writes to rows such as 12/25 while the Mamba copy lifecycle read manager rows such as 1/2. Strict replay still failed and no performance or quality test was admitted.
successor.v12r22_readiness_gate: Plugin-only fix normalizes every live Ascend GDN metadata block id by input_batch.block_table[0].blocks_per_kv_block before native execution, then applies the copied running-state destination. The state-row verdict ignores pre-copy identity events and requires every exact copy boundary to match normalized source and destination rows. The software gate passed 189 tests and the 26-skill maintainer tree validation. The physical NPU4-7 launch then stopped fail-closed before readiness as not_run/resource_race: four target-card PIDs appeared that were absent from docker top's owned PID set.
